name: Crazy Cattle Vita
author: LordChickenBlaster & Dimolade & Anna3d
description: Port of the Unity remake made by Dimolade. Welcome to Crazy Cattle 3D, an exhilarating battle royale game where you control explosive sheep in a chaotic survival challenge across three distinct global environments. Master physics-based movement, outwit your opponents, and be the last sheep standing!
